title: MAT Codex Code Exec — bundle manifest
description: Machine-readable index for MAT-2. Executors MUST reject any op not listed here (deny-by-default).
notes: Orchestrator (Claude Code) emits JSON only; it does not run implementation sandboxes directly unless a product-specific profile says otherwise.
Executor maps each op to a sandboxed Codex (or equivalent) invocation — no repo-wide shell; git scope is MAT-1 / MAT-12, not this bundle.
Session fields are optional; when present, executor must honor session_id + monotonic turn for resume semantics.
